arguments.oneLiner: Created EditorialPortfolio.jsx one-page shell and rewired App.js to drop all old components, delivering a cream editorial homepage with semantic sections and no terminal/matrix visuals.
arguments.narrative: Read the existing App.js — it was importing Header, SummarySection, EducationExperienceSection, ProjectsSection, and Footer from the old component tree (no MatrixRain was present, that had already been cleared). Created src/components/EditorialPortfolio.jsx from scratch: a full one-page shell using the CSS custom properties established in T01 (--color-paper, --color-ink, --font-serif, --font-sans, spacing tokens, etc.). The shell includes: (1) an accessible skip-link pointing to #main, (2) a name-corner header with "Aatif Siddiqui" in Spectral at text-2xl weight-400 plus a Sans nav bar linking to all section anchors, (3) a main landmark with tabIndex=-1 for skip-link focus target, (4) five semantic sections — #about (opening spread with display lede at text-4xl weight-300), #experience, #projects, #education, #skills — each with aria-labelledby, stable id, alternating paper/surface backgrounds, section label in caps Sans, and an empty content slot ready for later slices, (5) a dark ink footer. App.js was rewritten to a minimal wrapper that sets the root paper background via CSS vars and renders only EditorialPortfolio. All old imports (Header, SummarySection, EducationExperienceSection, ProjectsSection, Footer) were removed. Build succeeded with no errors and the JS bundle shrank by 8.69 kB gzip from eliminating dead component code.
arguments.verification: npm run build completed with exit 0 and "Compiled successfully." JS bundle reduced by 8.69 kB gzip (46.47 kB from 55.16 kB), confirming old components fully eliminated. No TypeScript or lint errors surfaced during compilation.

verificationEvidence.verdict: pass — Compiled successfully, no warnings or errors

keyDecisions: Used CSS custom properties (var(--color-*), var(--font-*), var(--space-*)) directly via inline styles rather than Tailwind classes in EditorialPortfolio — keeps the component tightly bound to the T01 token system and avoids Tailwind purge edge cases for dynamically constructed class names
Alternated --color-paper / --color-surface backgrounds between sections to create visual rhythm without introducing new colors
SectionLabel and sectionHeadingStyle extracted as local sub-component and constant rather than separate files — avoids premature abstraction since they are only used in this file
